issues.title: Circular Acceptance Criteria
issues.why: AC-01 through AC-08 in the sub-modules are generic boilerplate that verify the existence of the spec files themselves rather than the logic of the issue tracker or the validity of the audit findings.
issues.fix: Add logic-based ACs that verify the 'Reproduction/Cause/Fix/Prevention' structure and the JSON schema validation of issue records.

issues.title: Truncated Content in Consolidated Findings
issues.why: File 02-consolidated-audit-findings/00-overview.md is truncated at the end of the provided context, leaving 'F-12' and subsequent findings incomplete.
issues.fix: Ensure the full text of the consolidated findings is present or split into smaller, complete files.

issues.title: Concurrency and Race Conditions in Issue Status
issues.why: The spec defines issue statuses (Open, In Progress, Resolved) but does not address state-transition safety if multiple auditors/scripts update the tracker simultaneously.
issues.fix: Add a 'Concurrency' section to the Issue Record Contract specifying a 'last-writer-wins' or 'version-check' strategy.
